body:
## Why (verified evidence)

`_find_delta_metric` in `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:766-768` returns `str(record[key])` without a finite guard, unlike exposure parsing which uses `_parse_float` at `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:712-723`. When manifest `top_changes_per_variant` contains `notional_change: nan`, `_format_deltas` and `build_guarded_prompt` emit the literal string `nan` into offline stub answers and the `TOP_DELTAS` untrusted block sent to the LLM.

Reproduction on tip `1f72351`: `_format_deltas({"all_programs": [{"counterparty": "X", "notional_change": float("nan")}]})` contains `nan`; `build_guarded_prompt` for `show deltas` also contains `nan`.

## Scope

Harden chat delta formatting so non-finite manifest values cannot reach operator answers or guarded prompts.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:757-768`, route delta metric values through `_parse_float` in `_find_delta_metric` and omit or label non-finite values in `_format_deltas`.
- [ ] Add `tests/test_chat_session.py::test_format_deltas_omits_non_finite_notional_change` covering NaN and inf `notional_change` inputs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Named test: `pytest tests/test_chat_session.py::test_format_deltas_omits_non_finite_notional_change -q` passes.
- Deliberate-break → revert: restore bare `str(record[key])` in `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:768` → confirm `test_format_deltas_omits_non_finite_notional_change` FAILS → revert → passes.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT change exposure parsing already guarded in `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:712-723`.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: a test that only checks exposures but not delta formatting is a failure of this issue.

## Implementation Notes

#1085 hardened `top_changes()` in rollups; #1036 hardened exposure parsing in chat. Delta formatting was not updated.

_Surfaced by Track D audit 2026-09-21; verified by live repro on tip `1f72351`._
title: [P2] Chat delta formatter emits non-finite notional_change values
